skill.name: knowledge-work-bio-research
skill.description: Use when accelerating early-stage life sciences R&D with preclinical tools for literature search, genomics analysis, and drug target prioritization.
whenToUse: Running QC on scRNA-seq data and then integrating or batch-correcting with deep-learning models
Running nf-core sequencing pipelines (RNA-seq, variant calling, ATAC-seq) on local or public GEO/SRA data
Searching biomedical literature and prioritizing drug targets for early discovery
Converting lab instrument output files to a standard Allotrope Simple Model format

keyConcepts.explanation: Automated QC for scRNA-seq following scverse best practices, supporting .h5ad and .h5 files with MAD-based filtering and visualizations.
Deep-learning toolkit for single-cell omics covering scVI, scANVI, totalVI, PeakVI, MultiVI, DestVI, veloVI, and sysVI for integration, batch correction, label transfer, and multi-modal analysis.
Runs nf-core bioinformatics pipelines including rnaseq (differential expression), sarek (germline/somatic variant calling), and atacseq (chromatin accessibility).
Converts instrument output (PDF, CSV, Excel, TXT) to Allotrope Simple Model format across 40+ instrument types like plate readers, qPCR, and chromatography systems.
A systematic research problem-selection framework based on Fischbach & Walsh, covering ideation, risk assessment, optimization, decision trees, and synthesis.
Bundles data sources including NLM literature, bioRxiv/medRxiv, Consensus, OpenTargets, clinical trial registries, BioRender, and Benchling for research workflows.

gotchas: Some MCP servers (10X Genomics txg-mcp, ToolUniverse) require a separate binary download and are not bundled
Skills are Apache 2.0, but MCP servers are third-party — check each provider's own terms before use
Run the bundled /start command first to see which tools are actually connected and available
Benchling and several connectors are placeholders that must be wired up before genomics/lab workflows work
The plugin targets preclinical, early-stage R&D; it is not a substitute for validated clinical analysis
